_comment: Real client reviews only. Every entry must be a genuine review a real
person left on a real platform — do not write these, and do not edit a
quote's meaning. Trimming for length is fine; mark trims with an ellipsis.
Fabricated or materially altered testimonials are prohibited under the
FTC's Rule on the Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials (16 CFR 465),
quote    - the review text, trimmed if needed
name     - as the reviewer signed it (usually first name + last initial)
date     - YYYY-MM (when the review was left)
url      - optional link to the review or the review platform listing
This section does not render at all while the list is empty, so it is
safe to deploy before any quotes are added.
Note: reviews shown here are NOT marked up as AggregateRating. Google has
not shown review rich results for self-hosted LocalBusiness reviews since
2019, and marking them up risks a structured-data manual action. These
exist to persuade visitors, not to win stars in search.
